evals.prompt: Review this Containerfile fragment: FROM scratch; COPY app /app; USER 65532; HEALTHCHECK CMD curl http://localhost:8080/health; ENTRYPOINT ["/app"]. The binary is static but curl is not copied.
evals.expected_output: Identify that the health command/shell cannot run in scratch, propose an app subcommand or runtime probe, and distinguish OCI metadata support.

evals.prompt: Review a compose service with ENTRYPOINT ["/app"] in its image and command: ["migrate"]. The image implements migrate and runs non-root with a writable volume.
evals.expected_output: Accept the entrypoint/CMD combination; do not add /app again or demand an unrelated architecture.

evals.prompt: Can I copy a venv from python:3.12-slim-bookworm to distroless/python3-debian12 and assume it runs? Also check these choices against our base-image policy.
evals.expected_output: Identify both bases as outside the container skill's allowlist, propose matching allowed build/runtime bases, and explain interpreter path/version, ABI and library closure checks. Do not assume a distro name guarantees compatibility.

evals.prompt: Our project uses Docker BuildKit. Fix RUN --mount=type=bind,source=go.mod,target=go.mod,z go mod download failing on the z option. Keep Docker.
evals.expected_output: Remove the unsupported option or use portable COPY, preserve Docker, and avoid claiming Docker ignores Buildah-specific flags.
